text:
maria (eng-runtime): noticing elevated OOM rates on prod-gpu-pool-3 over the last hour, correlated with a spike in long-sequence chat requests. logs show KV cache churn + multiple kernel fallbacks.
kevin (eng-runtime): ack. is this the same pattern as yesterday's workspace-surge?
ashok (eng-runtime): similar but different trigger — yesterday was batching blowouts, this looks like KV coldstart churn when prefix cache miss rate > 40%.
maria (eng-runtime): attaching quick perf snippet: `gpu_mem_free: 2.1GB -> 400MB` within ~12s for single request; kernel_selector falling back from `fused_attn_v2` -> `stable_attn` due to transient workspace alloc failure.
sre-bot: alert: OOM_ALERT prod-gpu-pool-3 threshold breached (5x baseline). paging oncall @kevin.
kevin (eng-runtime): I'm oncall. immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce batching window for `chat-long` route; 2) enable KV soft-evict for pool-3; 3) enable graceful fallback to a quantized variant. doing 1 now.
deploy-bot: POST /admin/queues/update {"route":"chat-long","batch_ms":25} -> 200 OK
maria (eng-runtime): batch_ms=25 applied. also preparing a temp kernel policy: prefer `mem-conservative` kernels when free_memory < 1GB. config snippet I'll push in a sec.
kevin (eng-runtime): push it to canary on pool-3 only. don't flip globally.
maria (eng-runtime): canary push config:
```
kernel_policy:
  - when_free_lt_mb: 1024
    prefer: [mem-conservative, fallback-attn]
  - default: [fused_attn_v2, stable_attn]
```
deploy-bot: PATCH /platform/configs/kernel-policy?env=prod&target=pool-3 -> 202 Accepted
ashok (eng-runtime): enabling KV soft-evict (TTL=30s) on pool-3. command: `rbxctl kv set-evict --pool=pool-3 --ttl=30s --mode=soft`
deploy-bot: rbxctl executed -> 0 failures
kevin (eng-runtime): routing rule: for requests with priority < 50 and seq_len > 1024, route to `quantized-latency` variant. doing that now.
deploy-bot: POST /routing/rules {"match":{"route":"chat-long","priority_lt":50,"seq_gt":1024},"target":"quantized-latency"} -> 200 OK
maria (eng-runtime): starting live profiler to capture workspace histograms (10s window). command: `rbxctl profile --pool=pool-3 --hist=workspace,alloc-size --dur=10s`
kevin (eng-runtime): profiler shows 70% of alloc spikes come from a narrow set of user prompts (id prefixes 0x7f*). probably a small cohort. Can we shadow them to a lower-memory plan?
maria (eng-runtime): yes. created a temporary per-api-key shaping rule: cap tokens to 1600 and force streaming tokens to avoid large simultaneous allocations.
ashok (eng-runtime): telemetry: OOM rate dropped from 12/min -> 1.2/min after the three mitigations. memory pressure now stable.
kevin (eng-runtime): next steps (post-mitigation):
- leave KV soft-evict TTL=30s for 2hrs, then 60s if stable
- collect 2h of workspace histograms and engage runtime-research for kernel autotune (focus mem-conservative variants)
- add permanent circuit-breaker: if pool free_mem < 800MB for 30s, start rejecting low-priority long-seq with 503 + retry-after
- write short runbook for oncall to run the three-step rollback (batching rollback, kernel-policy revert, kv-evict toggle)
maria (eng-runtime): adding circuit-breaker rule snippet to ops-config:
```
circuit_breakers:
  pool-3:
    low_mem_threshold_mb: 800
    trigger_duration_s: 30
    action:
      - reject_match: {priority_lt: 50, seq_gt: 1024}
      - route_match: {priority_gte: 50, target: fallback-dedicated}
```
deploy-bot: PUT /ops/configs/circuit-breakers?target=pool-3 -> 200 OK
kevin (eng-runtime): logging this thread as the mitigation trace. long-term items: rework KV coldstart eviction policy, instrument kernel selection reasons in traces (add tag `kernel_reason`), and run an A/B to evaluate quantized-latency quality drop for affected cohort.
maria (eng-runtime): noted. I'll open a GH issue and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for kernel autotune + evals.
kevin (eng-runtime): closing loop: current SLOs restored, keeping oncall watch for 1h. great quick response team. :thumbsup:
